_note: The curated Keune product wall on /butik (/en/shop), 2026-09-29. ORDER IS RENDER ORDER within each line; the page groups rows by `line` (care, style, 1922, so-pure — any other value is not rendered). `slug` is the /se/p/<slug>/ segment from Keune's own sitemap, and every CTA is built from it by keuneLink() in src/lib/keune.ts — the salon-attributed deep link. Never paste a raw keune.com URL into a row. `price` is Keune's SEK price at `_synced`; `npm run keune:check` reports drift, `npm run keune:update` rewrites it. Blurbs are NOVO's own words and say only what a product is FOR (no efficacy claims, MFL 2008:486 §10).
_licence: Product images are Keune's own renders (cdn.shopify.com), downloaded unmodified 2026-09-29 and wired on the same pre-production call as the brand logos: permission is ASSUMED GRANTED BY GO-LIVE and requested in the same mail as the Keune logo approval (still pending — see brands.json _licence). If Keune has not granted by then, blank `image` on every row: the card falls back to a typeset card by design, so blanking is the whole removal path.
